user.description: Choose a Kubu sensor found nearby.

login.title: Sign in to Kubu
login.description:
Sign in with the email and password you use in the Kubu app. Home Assistant uses this once to get the key for {name}. Your email and password are not saved, and after setup the sensor is read locally over Bluetooth.

The sensor must already be set up in the Kubu app.

error.invalid_auth: Wrong email or password. Accounts that sign in with Google are not supported.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Kubu cloud. Try again later.
error.not_in_account: This sensor is not in your Kubu account. Set it up in the Kubu app first.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many failed sign-ins. Kubu has locked sign-in for 5 minutes; wait and try again.
error.email_not_verified: Your email is not verified yet. Verify it from the Kubu app, then try again.

abort.already_configured: This device is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No Kubu sensors found nearby. Make sure Bluetooth is set up and active scanning is on.
